svg.text: The details of the SA14-077 Control Subassembly are described under that particular
This unit contains the latching circuitry for both the Program Channel switch and
the Solo switch: These latches may be controlled either locally by momentary push-
button SW19 and SW2O, Or remotely through the console control system
DS4 is the Channel On tally and DSS is the Solo On tally.
Eight tally sense points are fed into the control system via the control assembly.
The SA14-077 is powered by +12 volts which appears at P2 pin Y
common connects to P2 pin V of the module connector.
an active decoupler consisting of Q12 through Q17 with their associated components
Q14 and Q15 are current limit sensors for the positive and negative voltage supply
the +/-25 volt supplies is at P2 pins 20 and X, while the
main frame chassis connection is at P2 pin 22.
